title: Fix position of cart crosselling hook
issue_title: [FO] - Cross selling practically impossible with current Classic theme setup
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Is your feature request related to a problem?

Featured products are hooked (besides `displayHome`) only to `displayCrossSellingShoppingCart` inside **cart-empty.tpl**
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/50b0b86d86cb34fdcde04502fdc774bce8176ac5/themes/classic/templates/checkout/cart-empty.tpl#L28
which practically is never loaded (only way to open this page is to refresh the cart after you remove all the products - noone does that),
or to `displayOrderConfirmation2` inside **order-confirmation.tpl**
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/50b0b86d86cb34fdcde04502fdc774bce8176ac5/themes/classic/templates/checkout/order-confirmation.tpl#L111
which loads only after the order has just been placed. It seems pointless at this stage as it forces the client, if interested in any of these products, to place another order and go through whole proccess again.

There's also **Cross selling** module available but this is hooked only to `displayFooterProduct` on main product page.

### Describe the solution you'd like

When a client adds a product to the cart or checks out cart later, then featured and/or crossselling products should be also loaded to provide possible new items for the cart, before the order is placed.

### Alternatives you've considered

![csps](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5007456/142290505-bd1ec1e3-2094-4676-955c-042fdd9dcce8.gif)

<hr>

#### Describe the bug

Actually, we can find a combination by reference only related to a specific product.
We could be retrieve combination in global context without take in consideration a specific product.

> Reported [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/26467) by @saiif

$id = Combination::getIdByReference(500);
return the same id

cause like is used for the query

return the same id

title: Fix SQL query in OrderQueryBuilder
issue_title: BO - Orders - impossible to extend order grid query from module
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When you try to modify Orders list query from a module using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook, always gets an error by using the "New client" filter.

#### Expected behavior

A module could extend orders list query using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook with no errors.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Develop a module to add a new column on backoffice Orders grid using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook.
2. Add a new data column to Orders grid (similar to example for Customers grid from official doc: https://devdocs.prestashop.com/1.7/modules/sample-modules/grid-and-identifiable-object-form-hooks-usage/#extending-grid-query-builder)
2. Click on backoffice Orders menu
3. Use "New client" filter with any value (Yes or No) and click on Search button
4. An error 500 is shown due to and incorrect table alias

**Screenshots**

- Module hooks code:
![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567527-49093a00-c9e4-11eb-9d18-16fa920a64ad.JPG)
![2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567547-4dcdee00-c9e4-11eb-9236-9edd66e36a34.JPG)

hookActionOrderGridDefinitionModifier code:
```
public function hookActionOrderGridDefinitionModifier(array $params)
{
    $definition = $params['definition'];

    $definition->getColumns()->addAfter(
        'date_add',
        (new BooleanColumn('from_app'))
            ->setName($this->l('App order'))
            ->setOptions([
                'field' => 'from_app',
                'true_name' => $this->trans('Yes', [], 'Admin.Global'),
                'false_name' => $this->trans('No', [], 'Admin.Global'),
                'clickable' => true,
            ])
    );

    $definition->getFilters()->add(
        (new Filter('from_app', YesAndNoChoiceType::class))
        ->setTypeOptions([
            'required' => false,
        ])    
        ->setAssociatedColumn('from_app')
    );
}

public function hookActionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier(array $params)
{
    $searchQueryBuilder = $params['search_query_builder'];

    $searchCriteria = $params['search_criteria'];

    $searchQueryBuilder->addSelect(
        'app.`id_order` IS NOT NULL AS `from_app`'
    );

    $searchQueryBuilder->leftJoin(
        'o',
        '`app_order_table`',
        'app',
        'app.`id_order` = o.`id_order`'
    );

    if ('from_app' === $searchCriteria->getOrderBy()) {
        $searchQueryBuilder->orderBy('app.`id_order`', $searchCriteria->getOrderWay());
    }

    foreach ($searchCriteria->getFilters() as $filterName => $filterValue) {
        if ('from_app' === $filterName) {
            $searchQueryBuilder->andWhere('app.`id_order` IS ' . ($filterValue ? 'NOT' : '') . ' NULL');
        }
    }
}
```
- Error details:
![3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567574-58888300-c9e4-11eb-848c-f746a80b4062.JPG)

#### Additional information

A further investigation show that error came from leftJoin alias used on $searchQueryBuilder modification. The problem is that standard "o" alias completly change on query builder when a "New client" filter is used. This is caused by an incorrect subquery that do not use standard "o" alias (in fact do not use any alias at all) on https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/src/Core/Grid/Query/OrderQueryBuilder.php#L275. This makes impossible to extend orders query using a join stament unless you remove "New client" filter and column from grid.

* PrestaShop version: develop
* PHP version: N/A

title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
issue_title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

When exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range), the footer of the following invoice is shown on the current invoice erroneously. This meant that in a multi-store environment, the wrong store details could be output on the invoice footer, which can create a compliance issue, especially if different tax information should be displayed. The issue resolves around the use of TCPDF, where the footer needs to be output after AddPage, otherwise the last page of a page group will end up having the footer of the next page group.

#### Expected behaviour

The footer should be output using the correct store details.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behaviour:

1. In a multi-store environment -- set up multiple stores with different data, such that the footers on invoices would differ depending on which store items were ordered from
2. Place and invoice a mixture of orders - switch between stores when placing orders
3. Export orders using the invoices by date range functionality
4. Where invoices switch between stores, the footer belonging to the store of the next invoice will be shown on the current invoice

I will submit a pull request with a fix.
